3114-00247 ' ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as ofthe 22 day of September, 2014, by and between LSG FULTON 08701 ("Owner") and CP V TS FULTON OWNER, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Carmel Partners, 1000 Sansome Street, Suite 180, San Francisco, CA 94111 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of 120 Fulton Street, New York, NY (Block 78, Lot 45 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map*), New York County (the "Owner Land"), and the building and improvements thereon (the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the "Owner Parcel") which is more fully described on Exhibit A, attached hereto; B- 78 WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of 112, 114, 116 and 118 Fulton Street, L- 45,47 New York, NY (Block 78, Lot 47 on the Tax Map, New York County (the “Developer Land"), which is more fully described on Exhibit B, attached hereto; WHEREAS, Developer may construct a new building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land and/or anyAdditional Parcel (as hereinafter defined), and construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements,repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building”; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, pursuant to the Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, the Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions-Expansion (112 Fulton Street) and the Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions-Expansion (7 Dutch and 45 John) (collectively, the “Declaration"), the Owner Parcel, the Developer Parcel, and the lands known as 86 Nassau Street (Block 78,Lot 40 on the Tax Map, New York County), 88 Nassau Street (Block 78, Lot 42 on the Tax Map, New York County), 122 Fulton Street (Block 78, Lot 44 on the Tax Map, New York County), 41-43 John Street (Block 78, Lots 1101-1102 on the Tax Map, New York County), 80-82 Nassau Street -1- 1

(Block 78,Lots 1201-1202 on the Tax Map,New York County), 9-15 Dutch Street (Block 78, Lots 1301-1303 on the Tax Map,New York County),45 John Street (Block 78,Lots 1701-1787 on the Tax Map,New York County),and 7 Dutch Street (Block 78,Lots 1801-1805 on the Tax Map,NewYork County) (the“Other Parcels”),have heretofore been merged in to a single zoning lot in accordance with the definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot") Agreements,each dated as of May30,2013,and recorded in the Recording Office as CRFN#s 2013000247601,2013000247617,2013000247614,and 2013000247610 and the Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of May 19, 2014 pertaining to 45 John Street and 7 Dutch Street, NewYork,NYrecorded in theRecording Office as CRFN#2014000190155(collectively,the "Other Parcel ZLDAs")and each of the amendments thereto(collectively,the Other ParcelZLDAs and the amendments thereto,the“Amended Other Parcel ZLDAs") listed on Schedule A,attached hereto;
